title: Among female patients with uric acid levels above the normal threshold (UA
question: Among female patients with uric acid levels above the normal threshold (UA > 6.5), identify those who either tested positive for abnormal anti-SSA or had a borderline-high IgA level (≥450). For this group, compute the average total cholesterol and then return the patient whose total cholesterol is closest to this average, along with their ID, sex, birthday, T-CHO value, and the computed average.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    p."XCL_058" AS pid,
    p."XCL_059" AS sex,
    p."XCL_060" AS birthday,
    l."XCL_026" AS tcho
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p."XCL_058" = l."XCL_014"
  WHERE p."XCL_059" = 'F'
    AND l."XCL_022" > 6.5
    AND (l."XCL_053" NOT IN ('0', 'negative') OR l."XCL_034" >= 450)
),
avgc AS (
  SELECT AVG(tcho) AS avg_tcho FROM base WHERE tcho IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  b.pid AS "ID",
  b.sex AS "sex",
  b.birthday AS "birthday",
  b.tcho AS "T-CHO",
  a.avg_tcho AS "average"
FROM base AS b
CROSS JOIN avgc AS a
WHERE b.tcho IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(b.tcho - a.avg_tcho)
LIMIT 1;

    l."XCL_026" AS tcho
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p."XCL_058" = l."XCL_014"
  WHERE p."XCL_059" = 'F'
    AND l."XCL_022" > 6.5
    AND (l."XCL_053" NOT IN ('0', 'negative') OR l."XCL_034" >= 450)
),
avgc AS (
  SELECT AVG(tcho) AS avg_tcho FROM base WHERE tcho IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  b.pid AS "ID",
  b.sex AS "sex",
  b.birthday AS "birthday",
  b.tcho AS "T-CHO",
  a.avg_tcho AS "average"
FROM base AS b
CROSS JOIN avgc AS a
WHERE b.tcho IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(b.tcho - a.avg_tcho)
LIMIT 1;
